    "role":"source",
    "note":"get_glyph_name copies truncated glyph name into the 5-byte stack buffer buf, producing a 4-char string"},
   {"step":2,"file":"test/api/test-ot-face.c","function":"test_face",
    "line":62,"var":"buf","code":"hb_font_get_glyph_from_name (font, buf, strlen (buf), &g);",

   {"step":3,"file":"src/hb-ot-post-table.hh","function":"OT::post::accelerator_t::get_glyph_from_name",
    "line":168,"var":"st","code":"hb_bytes_t st (name, len);",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"Constructs hb_bytes_t with arrayZ pointing to the 5-byte stack buffer"},
   {"step":4,"file":"src/hb-ot-post-table.hh","function":"OT::post::accelerator_t::get_glyph_from_name",
    "line":169,"var":"&st","code":"const uint16_t *gid = (const uint16_t *) hb_bsearch_r (&st, gids, count, sizeof (gids[0]), cmp_key, (void *) this);",
    "role":"root_cause",
    "note":"operator& on hb_array_t returns arrayZ (pointer to 5-byte buf) instead of address of the struct; bsearch receives wrong pointer as key"},
   {"step":5,"file":"src/hb-ot-post-table.hh","function":"OT::post::accelerator_t::cmp_key",
    "line":204,"var":"key","code":"const hb_bytes_t *key = (const hb_bytes_t *) pk;",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"Casts the pointer-to-buf (5 bytes) to hb_bytes_t* which requires 12 bytes (8-byte pointer + 4-byte len)"},
   {"step":6,"file":"src/hb-array.hh","function":"hb_array_t<char const>::cmp",
    "line":100,"var":"a.len","code":"if (len != a.len) return (int) a.len - (int) len;",
    "role":"sink",
    "note":"Dereferencing *key reads 12 bytes from 5-byte stack buffer causing stack-buffer-overflow READ 4"}
 ],

   "propagation":[
     {"from":{"file":"src/hb-ot-post-table.hh","function":"OT::post::accelerator_t::get_glyph_name",

      "to":{"file":"src/hb-ot-post-table.hh","function":"OT::post::accelerator_t::get_glyph_from_name",

      "type":"data","via":["buf"]},
     {"from":{"file":"src/hb-ot-post-table.hh","function":"OT::post::accelerator_t::get_glyph_from_name",
       "line":169,"operands":["&st"]},
      "to":{"file":"src/hb-array.hh","function":"hb_array_t<char const>::cmp",
